question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation constitute a great accomplishment
Such accomplishment belongs to the practitioner
This accomplishment inspires affection in the yoginīs
inference: A practitioner possessing the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: He may become dear to the yoginīs, possessing the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation.
